business_rules: If not a formal letter and HeadingID equals SignatureImageCodeID, Response is set to SignatureImageStaffID.
Apply language translations if alt language fields are used.
validations: Non-formal letters require non-blank Response unless HeadingID corresponds to blank row or signature image.
Signature image requires a non-zero SignatureImageStaffID.
calculations: Calculate SortOrderFormatted to display SortOrder or blank if -1.
Set NumberCharacter and NumberingIndentLevel based on NumberingCode and previous entry.
conditions: IsLeft, IsCenter, IsRight, and IsJustify return true when Alignment matches the respective condition.
system_behavior: Format entry descriptions to respond to specified font styles and sizes.
Ensure that header entries are not repeated and reset numbering codes for new headers.
